title: FlatCraft: Minimal Pack
description: FlatCraft is a simple, flat-style resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition.
body:
FlatCraft is a simple, flat-style resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. 

All textures are drawn in 16x16 resolution with pure colors — no gradients, no noise, no unnecessary details. Just clean, crisp blocks and items.

1) Flat colors only
2) All blocks and items retextured
3) Perfect for minimalistic builds or PvP
4) Lightweight, no performance impact

Created by Frog3270. First release — version 1.0.
